info.description: Init — PolyBLEP into Output (same as patches/init.json)

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

harmonics.tooltip: Partial count (1…1024). Instant/Smoothed round to integer slots. Decimal keeps a trailing fractional amp (32.4 → 32 full + slot 33×0.4). Bubble Cutoff can still apply its own skirt.

waveform.tooltip: Saw / Square / PulseCenter / PulseLeft / PulseRight / Tri / RectSine. PWM only affects Pulse*.

pwm.tooltip: Pulse* only. Bipolar (−1…+1): 0 = 50% duty, −1…+1 → ~2%…~98% width. Ignored by Saw / Square / Tri / RectSine.

phaseRotation.tooltip: Adds the same phase offset (cycles) to every harmonic in the Graph.

curve.tooltip: Rational = one-sided bend. Bipolar Rational = S-curve between Slope Start and Slope End.

slopeStart.tooltip: Harmonic number (decimal) where the slope begins. Partials below it stay at full level.

slopeEnd.tooltip: Harmonic number (decimal) where the slope reaches 1 − Slope. Follows Harmonics while it sits at the harmonic count, and always stays above Slope Start.

skew.tooltip: Curve bend (−1…+1). 0 = straight line from Slope Start to Slope End.

slope.tooltip: 0…1. Linear amplitude drop from Slope Start to Slope End. Partials past Slope End sit at 1 − Slope. Harmonic 1 always keeps full level.

harmonicFade.tooltip: Instant = hard H snap (no amp crossfade). Smoothed = 1-quantum amp lerp on slot-count change (default). Decimal = live trailing partial amp from fractional Harmonics (no quantum lerp).

frequency.tooltip: Fundamental in Hz. A cable on ƒ replaces this, one value per sample.

seed.tooltip: Random phase seed for newly added partials (Phase Entry = Random).

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: Triangle: 0 = sine, 1 = triangle. Same shape at every pitch. Other waveforms still use Softwave drive (Morph⁴ × sine_amp).

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0…1 = full-scale bipolar wave. Min/max are guides only.

drive.tooltip: Input push into the soft-knee curve.

threshold.tooltip: Amplitude (0...1) where limiting starts. Below this the driven signal is unchanged.

knee.tooltip: How gradual the transition from Threshold toward full scale is. 0 = hard at Threshold.

highFreq.tooltip: Sweep start frequency (the click). Latched on each Trigger. Clamped to 50 Hz ... half the sample rate.

lowFreq.tooltip: Frequency the sweep settles toward (a tuned body). 0 = keeps falling. Latched on each Trigger.

sweepTime.tooltip: Time to fall from High Freq to Low Freq + 50 Hz. Latched on each Trigger. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

chirp.tooltip: Tail power of the sweep. + holds the highs longer, then drops fast. - drops fast at first, then lingers low. Acts at once. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

chirpShape.tooltip: Attack knee vs decay at the same tail power. + keeps the start frequency a little longer, - rounds the knee. Acts at once. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

wave.tooltip: Waveform family. Sine. TriSaw = triangle that morphs to saws with Wave Shape. SinFatSaw = sine-shaped TriSaw (bulging fat saws). From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

waveShape.tooltip: Saw-down (-1) ... symmetric (0) ... saw-up (+1). No effect on Sine. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

phase.tooltip: Start phase offset. Trigger hard-resets the oscillator to this phase. 0 = clean start at zero. +-0.25 = starts at a peak: hard click.

decay.tooltip: Amplitude envelope: seconds to fall 60 dB (T60) after a hit. Drives Env and the Kick level. Acts at once.

amplitude.tooltip: Kick output level. Does not scale Env.

offset.tooltip: Bias. Off/On choices by default. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.

freqUpdate.tooltip: When ƒ changes mid-cycle: On cycle waits for wrap; Warp remaining keeps dither offset; Snap remaining re-dithers the remaining length.

waveform.tooltip: Cycle-dither AA oscillator (RS-MET). Saw = edge then down; Ramp = up then edge. Morph: Pulse = duty; Trisaw Center = opposing peaks toward saw; Analog Square = same-direction peaks (zeros at 0 / 0.5). Full Asym Sine = half-sine wavetable once per cycle (same fundamental as Sine), filled −1…+1 (Morph ignored). Squircle = sine to square (Morph 0 sine, Morph 1 square; not Analog Square). Center Pulse: high in the middle, width = Morph (0 constant -1, 1 constant +1).

frequency.tooltip: Absolute Hz. Converted to cycles/sample for cycle-dither. Update chooses how a mid-cycle ƒ change warps the remaining period (phase-continuous).

phase.tooltip: Phase used when Reset is triggered (or on first sample).

morph.tooltip: Universal morph 0...1 (always Morph). Pulse = duty/width; Trisaw Center = opposing peaks lean triangle into a saw (zeros at 0 / 0.5; Morph 0/1 bright mirrors, 0.5 dullest); Analog Square = same-direction peaks (dual-edge / square-ish at extremes); Full Asym Sine ignores Morph (half-sine LUT once per cycle, −1…+1). Squircle = sine to square (0 sine, 1 square). Center Pulse = width centered on mid-cycle (0 constant -1, 1 constant +1).

amplitude.tooltip: Linear output level 0…1 (guides only; MOD may exceed).

seed.tooltip: Dither noise seed. Same Seed = same output; new modules get their own.

offset.tooltip: Bias. The face edits this. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.
